      "formal_name": "Finsupp.weight",
      "informal_name": "Weighted sum of vectors indexed by σ over R",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "{σ : Type u_1} →\n  {M : Type u_2} →\n    {R : Type u_3} → [inst : Semiring R] → (σ → M) → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [Module R M] → (σ →₀ R) →+ M",
      "informal_description": "The additive homomorphism from the space of finite support functions $ \\sigma \\to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which maps each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \\sum_{i \\in \\text{support } d} d(i) \\cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $.",

    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finsupp.weight_apply",
      "informal_name": "Weighted Sum Evaluation: $ \\text{weight } w f = \\sum_{i \\in \\text{support } f} c_i \\cdot w(i) $",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]\n  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i",
      "informal_description": "For any finite support function $ f : \\sigma \\to_0 R $, the weight function applied to $ f $ is equal to the sum over all $ i $ in the support of $ f $ of $ c \\cdot w(i) $, where $ c $ is the coefficient of $ i $ in $ f $ and $ w : \\sigma \\to M $ is a function assigning vectors to indices.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finsupp.weight_sub_single_add",
      "informal_name": "Additivity of Weight Under Subtraction of a Single Element",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {w : σ → M} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : σ →₀ ℕ} {i : σ},\n  f i ≠ 0 → (Finsupp.weight w) (f - Finsupp.single i 1) + w i = (Finsupp.weight w) f",
      "informal_description": "For any finite support function $ f : \\sigma \\to_0 \\mathbb{N} $ and index $ i \\in \\sigma $ with $ f(i) \\neq 0 $, the weight of $ f - \\delta_i $ (where $ \\delta_i $ denotes the function taking value 1 at $ i $ and 0 elsewhere) satisfies $ \\text{weight}_w(f - \\delta_i) + w(i) = \\text{weight}_w(f) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finsupp.sum_nsmul",
      "informal_name": "Equality of Sums of Natural Scalar Multiples in Finite Support Functions",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {N : Type u_10} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : Fintype α] (f : α →₀ ℕ) (g : α → N),\n  (f.sum fun a b => b • g a) = ∑ a, f a • g a",
      "informal_description": "For a finite type $\\alpha$ and an additive commutative monoid $N$, given a finite support function $f : \\alpha \\to_0 \\mathbb{N}$ and a function $g : \\alpha \\to N$, the sum of $f(a) \\cdot g(a)$ over the support of $f$ is equal to the sum of $f(a) \\cdot g(a)$ over all elements of $\\alpha$. Here, $\\cdot$ denotes natural number scalar multiplication in the additive monoid $N$.",

      "formal_name": "Finsupp.le_weight",
      "informal_name": "Weighted Sum Inequality for Finite Support Functions",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : σ → ℕ) {s : σ}, w s ≠ 0 → ∀ (f : σ →₀ ℕ), f s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f",
      "informal_description": "For any function $ w : \\sigma \\to \\mathbb{N} $, element $ s \\in \\sigma $ with $ w(s) \\neq 0 $, and finite support function $ f : \\sigma \\to_0 \\mathbb{N} $, the value $ f(s) $ is less than or equal to the weighted sum $ \\sum_{t \\in \\text{support } f} w(t) \\cdot f(t) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight"
    }
  ]

items.informal_name: Weighted sum of vectors indexed by σ over R
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    {R : Type u_3} → [inst : Semiring R] → (σ → M) → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [Module R M] → (σ →₀ R) →+ M
items.informal_description: The additive homomorphism from the space of finite support functions $ \sigma \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which maps each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Evaluation: $ \text{weight } w f = \sum_{i \in \text{support } f} c_i \cdot w(i) $
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 R $, the weight function applied to $ f $ is equal to the sum over all $ i $ in the support of $ f $ of $ c \cdot w(i) $, where $ c $ is the coefficient of $ i $ in $ f $ and $ w : \sigma \to M $ is a function assigning vectors to indices.

items.informal_name: Additivity of Weight Under Subtraction of a Single Element
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {w : σ → M} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : σ →₀ ℕ} {i : σ},
  f i ≠ 0 → (Finsupp.weight w) (f - Finsupp.single i 1) + w i = (Finsupp.weight w) f
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $ and index $ i \in \sigma $ with $ f(i) \neq 0 $, the weight of $ f - \delta_i $ (where $ \delta_i $ denotes the function taking value 1 at $ i $ and 0 elsewhere) satisfies $ \text{weight}_w(f - \delta_i) + w(i) = \text{weight}_w(f) $.

items.informal_name: Equality of Sums of Natural Scalar Multiples in Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {N : Type u_10} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : Fintype α] (f : α →₀ ℕ) (g : α → N),
  (f.sum fun a b => b • g a) = ∑ a, f a • g a
items.informal_description: For a finite type $\alpha$ and an additive commutative monoid $N$, given a finite support function $f : \alpha \to_0 \mathbb{N}$ and a function $g : \alpha \to N$, the sum of $f(a) \cdot g(a)$ over the support of $f$ is equal to the sum of $f(a) \cdot g(a)$ over all elements of $\alpha$. Here, $\cdot$ denotes natural number scalar multiplication in the additive monoid $N$.

items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Inequality for Finite Support Functions
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : σ → ℕ) {s : σ}, w s ≠ 0 → ∀ (f : σ →₀ ℕ), f s ≤ (Finsupp.weight w) f
items.informal_description: For any function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, element $ s \in \sigma $ with $ w(s) \neq 0 $, and finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, the value $ f(s) $ is less than or equal to the weighted sum $ \sum_{t \in \text{support } f} w(t) \cdot f(t) $.
